title: 第十三章 喜悦

content_zh:
这时候，练武厅当中一名头发有些花白的中年人开口道：“白阳，这么跟你说。假如，你们不修导引术，单单使用‘五心向天修炼法’，一天可能炼化五分钟，你们的全身细胞就已经饱和。无法再吸收！”
“可如果修炼导引术，你们细胞的容量就大的多。可以让你们修炼八分钟，乃至十分钟，甚至于一个小时！”这中年人看向罗峰三人，“你们现在明白了吧？”
罗峰一听，这才恍然。
“导引术，就是让每一颗细胞，每天的饭量增加。”罗峰心中暗道，细胞吸收宇宙丝丝能量化为基因原能，就好比人吃饭！假设一个人只能吃下三碗饭，修炼导引术就是让人一天能吃五碗饭，十碗饭。
江年微笑道：“你们如果不修炼导引术，细胞能吸收的能量，假设为一个单位！一旦修炼导引术，细胞能吸收的能量就可能变为两个单位，三个单位，乃至更多！也就是说，你修炼一年，可能超过别人修炼十年！这就是导引术的魅力。”
在场武者们一个个都开口谈论着，显然在导引术上都有很多话。
“论导引术，世界第一强者，我极限武馆全球总馆主‘洪’就创出九套一等一的导引术。你们加入我极限武馆，武馆贡献度够高的话，就有机会学到这顶级导引术。”在场武者们都笑着诱惑着罗峰三人。
世界上各大势力，都是希望自家的武者越来越多的。
“教官。”罗峰忽然开口。
“嗯？”教官江年笑看向罗峰，“什么事？”
“教官，刚才和总教官一起出去的银发黑袍武者，他怎么一个眼神，就让我们没有反抗能力？这是武者的什么能力？”罗峰从未听说过，武者有这么厉害，所以很好奇的很。
教官江年微微一笑，旁边的一群武者们更是哈哈大笑。
“小子，和总教官一起走的那位，是精神念师！比我们武者数量还要稀少的多的精神念师。”武者们哈哈笑着说道，“当然精神念师一般也是武者！不过却是武者当中最可怕的存在。”
“精神念师？”罗峰心中一惊。
现如今网络发达，在网上罗峰就曾经看到过介绍，说精神念师是武者群体中很特殊的存在，也是非常可怕的存在。
不过到底哪里可怕，网络上没详细说明。
“等你以后，成为武者之后。很快会知道精神念师的。”教官江年笑道，“好了，今天准武者考核就到此为止。你们三个也可以回家了。嗯，准武者证书要通过上面盖章，输入公民身份信息当中。大概过几天才会到。到时候会通知你们的。好了，你们都回去吧。”
“是，教官。”
罗峰、杨武、白阳三人，当即转头一道离开了练武厅，在极限会馆前被小区的驻守军人们手持枪械监视着离开小区。
××××××

明月小区门口，罗峰、杨武、白阳三人都是一脸笑容。
“我叫白阳，是江南第一军校的。我老家就在扬州城，刚好暑假，所以就就近来这进行考核。”白阳伸出手，分别和罗峰、杨武握手，“很高兴能认识二位。”
江南第一军校？
自己本来就是想进这所军校的。
罗峰笑着道：“我叫罗峰，这位是杨武，我们俩都是宜安区极限武馆的。”
“罗峰兄弟将来肯定是前途无量，就是我们军校精英班，成为武者的都没多少。”白阳是很乐于交朋友的，对于如此年轻就跨入准武者行列的罗峰，他自然更加乐于结交。说不定将来罗峰就成为一个超级大人物。
旁边杨武哈哈笑道：“不说那么多了，咱们三个同一天同一个地方通过考核，也是缘分。今天是好日子，我们一起找个酒楼好好吃一顿，好好聊聊。”
“好。”白阳笑着应道。
“走。”罗峰也哈哈笑着。
三人刚刚准武者考核过关，都是意气奋发，选了一座酒楼一起吃了午饭，而后就分头各回各家。
××××××
罗峰今天喝了点酒，等到地铁上才想起要给家里打电话报喜。
不过，地铁中人太多。恐怕自己一开口说‘准武者考核过关’，肯定会引起围观：“算了，等出了地铁，再打电话不迟。”
乘坐地铁1号线到中安路站就直接出站，从中安路站换乘11号线要走好一会儿。

content_en:
At this time, a middle-aged man with gray hair in the martial arts training hall said: "Bai Yang, let me tell you this. If you don't practice the Daoyin Technique and just use the 'Five Hearts to the Sky Cultivation Method', you may refine it for five minutes a day, and the cells in your body will be saturated. You can no longer absorb it!"
"But if you practice Guidance, the capacity of your cells will be much larger. You can practice for eight minutes, or even ten minutes, or even an hour!" The middle-aged man looked at Luo Feng and the others, "Do you understand now?"
When Luo Feng heard this, he suddenly realized.
"The Guidance Technique is to increase the daily food intake of each cell." Luo Feng secretly thought in his heart. The cells absorb the energy of the universe and turn it into gene energy, just like people eating! Assuming that a person can only eat three bowls of rice, practicing Daoyin Technique means that a person can eat five or ten bowls of rice a day.
Jiang Nian smiled and said, "If you don't practice the Guidance Technique, the energy that your cells can absorb is assumed to be one unit! Once you practice the Guidance Technique, the energy that your cells can absorb may become two units, three units, or even more! In other words, if you practice it for one year, it may be more than others who practice it for ten years! This is the charm of the Guidance Technique."
The warriors present all started talking, and it was obvious that they all had a lot to say about the art of guidance.
"In terms of Guidance Technique, the world's strongest person, Hong, the global head of my Extreme Martial Arts Gym, has created nine sets of first-class Guidance Techniques. If you join our Extreme Martial Arts Gym, and if your contribution to the gym is high enough, you will have the opportunity to learn this top Guidance Technique." The warriors present all smiled and tempted Luo Feng and the others.
All the major forces in the world hope to have more and more warriors.
"Instructor." Luo Feng suddenly spoke.
"Huh?" Instructor Jiang Nianxiao looked at Luo Feng, "What's the matter?"
"Instructor, how come the silver-haired and black-robed warrior who went out with the chief instructor just now made us unable to resist with just one look? What kind of ability is this warrior?" Luo Feng had never heard of a warrior being so powerful, so he was very curious.
Instructor Jiang Nian smiled slightly, and the group of warriors next to him laughed even more.
"Boy, the one who walked with the chief instructor is a spiritual master! A spiritual master who is much rarer than us warriors." The warriors laughed and said, "Of course, spiritual masters are generally warriors! But they are the most terrifying existence among warriors."
"Psychic Master?" Luo Feng was shocked.
Nowadays, the Internet is developed, and Luo Feng once saw an introduction on the Internet, saying that the spiritual master is a very special existence among the group of warriors, and it is also a very terrifying existence.
However, there is no detailed explanation on the Internet about what is so scary.
"When you become a warrior in the future, you will know the spiritual master soon." Instructor Jiang Nian smiled and said, "Okay, that's the end of today's quasi-martialist assessment. The three of you can go home. Well, the quasi-martialist certificate must be stamped on it and the citizenship information must be entered. It will arrive in a few days. You will be notified then. Okay, you all go back."
"Yes, instructor."
Luo Feng, Yang Wu, and Bai Yang immediately turned around and left the martial arts training hall together. They were watched by the soldiers stationed in the community with guns as they left the community in front of the Extreme Hall.
××××××
At the entrance of Mingyue Community, Luo Feng, Yang Wu, and Bai Yang all had smiles on their faces.
"My name is Bai Yang, and I am from the Jiangnan First Military Academy. My hometown is in Yangzhou City, and it is during the summer vacation, so I came here for the assessment." Bai Yang stretched out his hand and shook hands with Luo Feng and Yang Wu respectively, "I'm glad to meet you two."
Jiangnan First Military Academy?
I originally wanted to enter this military academy.
Luo Feng smiled and said: "My name is Luo Feng, and this is Yang Wu. We are both from the Extreme Martial Arts School in Yi'an District."
"Brother Luo Feng will definitely have a bright future in the future. Even in the elite class of our military academy, not many will become warriors." Bai Yang is very willing to make friends.Luo Feng, who had entered the ranks of quasi-warriors at such a young age, was naturally more willing to make friends with him. Maybe Luo Feng will become a super big shot in the future.
Next to him, Yang Wu laughed and said, "Not much to say, it's fate that the three of us passed the exam at the same place on the same day. Today is a good day. Let's find a restaurant to have a good meal together and have a good chat."
"Okay." Bai Yang responded with a smile.
"Let's go." Luo Feng also laughed.
The three of them had just passed the martial arts test, and they were all in high spirits. They chose a restaurant to have lunch together, and then went back to their respective homes.
××××××
Luo Feng drank some wine today and waited until he got on the subway before he remembered to call home to tell the good news.
However, there are too many people in the subway. I'm afraid that as soon as I say, 'I passed the test to be a martial artist,' I will definitely attract onlookers: "Forget it, it's not too late to call again after we get out of the subway."
Take Metro Line 1 to Zhong'an Road Station and exit directly. It takes a while to transfer to Line 11 at Zhong'an Road Station.
